players.bio: Adyn Torres is an 18-year-old professional soccer player who currently plays as a defensive midfielder for Atlanta United FC in Major League Soccer. Born in Silver Spring, Maryland, on 13 November 2007, he is a Homegrown player and the first in the club's history to progress through every stage of their development pathway, from the Regional Development School to the senior team.

Ajani "Jay" Fortune (born 30 December 2002) is a Trinidadian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Born in the United States, he plays for the Trinidad and Tobago national team.

Aleksei Andreyevich Miranchuk (Russian: Алексей Андреевич Миранчук, born 17 October 1995) is a Russian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or striker for Atlanta United and the Russian national team.

Arif Kovac is a 19-year-old American forward who plays as a centre-forward for Atlanta United 2 in MLS NEXT Pro. Standing at an imposing height of 1.98 metres (6'6"), Kovac signed a pre-contract with the club in July 2024 and officially joined the roster for the 2025 season after transitioning from St. Louis Scott Gallagher SC.

Breel Donald Embolo (born 14 February 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Switzerland national team. Born in Cameroon, Embolo moved with his family to France before finally settling in Switzerland.

Cameron Gatlin Dunbar (born October 22, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Atlanta United 2 in MLS Next Pro. Career Dunbar spent time with the academy sides for Albion SC and LA Galaxy, before signing as a homegrown player with MLS side LA Galaxy on February 20, 2020.

Cayman Graybill Togashi (born 10 August 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United FC. Born in the United States, he has represented Japan at youth level.

Cooper Sanchez is an 18-year-old American professional soccer player who currently plays as a central midfielder for Atlanta United FC in Major League Soccer (MLS). As of May 2026, Sanchez has established himself as a rising star for Atlanta United. He recently made headlines by scoring his first senior goal on 28 April 2026, during a 2-0 victory over Charlotte FC in the U.S.

Daniel Chica is an American professional soccer defender who plays as a centre-back for Atlanta United 2 in MLS NEXT Pro. He signed with the club on 17 December 2025 for the 2026 season, with an optional extension for 2027.
Dominik Chong-Qui (born December 27, 2007) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United.

Elías de Jesús Báez Sotelo (born 18 October 2004) is a 21-year-old Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back. He signed with Atlanta United FC in Major League Soccer (MLS) on 3 February 2026, joining from Argentine side San Lorenzo.
Emmanuel Delan Junior Latte Lath (born 1 January 1999) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer side Atlanta .
Enea Mihaj is an Albanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United and the Albania national team.

Enzo Dovlo is a professional soccer player who plays as a forward and attacking midfielder for Atlanta United 2 in MLS NEXT Pro. He was selected 12th overall in the first round of the 2026 MLS SuperDraft by Atlanta United after they acquired the pick in a trade with FC Dallas.

Fabrice Jean-Ian "Fafà" Picault (born 23 February 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United and the Haiti national team. Born in the United States, he was initially called up by Haiti in 2014 for a friendly against Chile but did not make an appearance.

Gerardo Daniel "Tata" Martino (born 20 November 1962) is an Argentine professional football coach and former player who is the head coach of Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Martino played mostly for Newell's Old Boys in his native Rosario. He holds the record of appearances with the team playing a total of 505 matches in all official competitions.

Giuliano Galoppo (born 18 June 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine club River Plate, on loan from São Paulo. Galoppo joined Boca Juniors' youth ranks in 2014, after playing for Atlético de Rafaela. He had previously trained with clubs in Italy due to his father playing in the country. In 2016, Galoppo joined Banfield.
Ignacio Suarez-Couri is an active, rising midfielder for Atlanta United 2
Jayden Hibbert (born August 5, 2004) is a professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Born in the United States, he has represented Jamaica at international level.

Júnior Osmar Ignacio Alonso Mujica (born 9 February 1993) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays either as a centre back or a left back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Atlético Mineiro and the Paraguay national team.

Kenneth Miller (born 23 December 1979) is a Scottish professional football coach and former player, and is currently the assistant coach of Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Miller, who played as a striker, is one of only five post-war players to have played for both Rangers and Celtic.
Lucas Adrián Hoyos (born 29 April 1989) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United.

Luke Brennan (born February 24, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Career Early career Brennan joined the Atlanta United academy at the age of 12, just before the professional outfit began their inaugural Major League Soccer season.

Matías Galarza Fonda (born 11 February 2002) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United on loan from Argentinian club River Plate and the Paraguay national team.
Matthew Edwards (born February 16, 2003) is an American soccer player who plays for Atlanta United in Major League Soccer.

Miguel Ángel Almirón Rejala (born 10 February 1994) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United and the Paraguay national team. Almirón began his career at Cerro Porteño and transferred to Lanús in 2015. After winning the 2016 Argentine Primera División, he signed for Atlanta United for $8 million.

Paulo César Díaz Huincales (Latin American Spanish: born 25 August 1994), known as Paulo Díaz, is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División club River Plate and the Chile national team. He got his first call up to the senior Chile squad for a friendly against the United States in January 2015 and made his international debut in the match.

Ronald José Hernández Pimentel (born 21 September 1997) is a Venezuelan professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United and the Venezuela national team. On 31 January 2020, Hernández signed for Scottish top-flight team Aberdeen on a four-and-a-half year deal. In doing so he became the club's first ever Venezuelan player. International.

Saba Lobjanidze (born 18 December 1994) is a Georgian professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United, and the Georgia national team. In early August 2023, Lobjanidze moved to MLS club Atlanta United on a three-year deal.

Sérgio Henrique Santos Gomes (born 4 September 1994) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as forward for Atlanta United in Major League Soccer. Early life Santos was born in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. Growing up in the Ana Lucía neighborhood of Belo Horizonte, Santos worked as a bricklayer and construction worker to help his family.
Steven Alzate (born 8 September 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United.

Stian Rode Gregersen (born 17 May 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defender or defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United and the Norway national team. Club career Gregersen was brought to Molde from Clausenengen in 2012. In March 2015, Gregersen joined Kristiansund on loan for the 2015 season.

Tomás Jacob is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Atlanta United. Career Born in Santa Fe, Argentina, Jacob came through the Newell's Old Boys academy system before making his first-team debut against Independiente on October 31, 2021.

Tristan Muyumba Nkita (born 7 March 1997) is a French footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Atlanta United. Club career Monaco Muyumba made his professional debut on 26 April 2017 in the Coupe de France semi-final against Paris Saint-Germain. He started the game and played the whole match in a 5–0 away loss.
William James Reilly is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Atlanta United in Major League Soccer.
